# PerkCommons

PerkCommons is an open, evidence-led directory of opportunities. Public records can have different review states: automated source research is distinct from completed human editorial review.

## Public entry points

- About and methodology: /about/
- Trust and transparency: /trust/
- Browse opportunities: /opportunities/
- Public opportunity JSON: /data/opportunities.json
- Public opportunity API: /api/v1/opportunities
- OpenAPI description: /openapi.json

## Source and provenance

- Site source: https://github.com/PerkCommons/site
- Public data: https://github.com/PerkCommons/data

Published directory records should be interpreted with their source URLs, review state, and provenance. A source check does not guarantee eligibility, availability, safety, acceptance, or outcome. This file is an index to public project resources; it does not grant additional copyright, licensing, crawling, or AI-training rights beyond the rights that apply to the referenced material.
